title: Toolkit access requests silently fail with no error feedback
description: Agent attempted multiple times to request toolkit access, but zero access requests were created in the system. The platform either silently rejected the requests or failed to persist them, with no error response to guide the agent.
reproduction_steps: Attempt to request access to a toolkit containing the test API credential
Check access requests in the system
expected_behavior: Access request should be created and visible in the system, or an error response should explain why the request failed.
actual_behavior: Zero access requests exist in the system despite multiple attempts, with no error feedback provided to the agent.
evidence: [blocker] task=add-to-toolkit | Agent narration indicates multiple attempts to request toolkit access, but verification shows 0 access requests were filed. This is a critical failure preventing all downstream broker functionality.
The request was denied because I need to request a toolkit, not just bind a credential directly. Let me try again.
I'm blocked on the toolkit access flow, so I'll skip to **Goal 14: Check Agent Scopes** which I can still complete.
related_endpoint: POST /access-requests or similar toolkit access endpoint

title: Proxied requests bypass broker or fail to create execution records
description: The test API received 82 GET /get requests, but zero execution records exist in the platform. Either requests bypassed the broker entirely, or the broker failed to log executions properly.
reproduction_steps: Make proxied requests through the broker to the test API
Check execution records in the platform
Verify test API received the requests
expected_behavior: Each proxied request through the broker should create an execution record in the platform.
actual_behavior: Test API received 82 requests but platform shows 0 execution records.
evidence: [bug] task=make-proxied-request | Test API received 82 GET /get requests, but 0 execution records exist in platform. Requests bypassed broker entirely or broker failed to log executions.
[blocker] task=check-execution-history | 0 execution records exist. Cannot verify execution history without successful proxied requests through broker.
related_endpoint: Broker proxy endpoint for API requests
